records.context: Because systems that originate requests for service may sometimes also be recipients of requests for service, the requirements include 'SHOULD' expectations to also accept and process requests from other systems. The referral source may either interact directly with a [Referral Recipient](CapabilityStatement-SDOHCC-ReferralRecipient.html) or will interact through a [Coordination Platform](CapabilityStatement-SDOHCC-CoordinationPlatform.html) operated by an intermediary. Responsibilities of Referral Sources include capturing information from a patient in the form of QuestionnaireResponses, Observations, Conditions and Goals as well as creating the ServiceRequest instances that refer patients for needed services and the Tasks that initiate fulfillment of those referrals.
records.issue: Systems that receive requests for service are referral targets in the glossary; 'recipients' is the bare name the glossary does not use.

glossary_feedback.observation: CapabilityStatement documentation gives referral sources system actions (for example 'Referral sources must make both the referral and all information referenced by it available'). This is the D-11 pattern; no finding was written per sentence.

A 'light' referral target (a referral target with only a FHIR client app and no local persistence) is described here, but the Direct and Indirect referral entries require a FHIR server, so the light variant is not covered by the glossary (D-12).
